patches.description: Unlocks all premium features. Requires root: the patched build must be mounted over the genuine Play-signed install — a re-signed sideload will not work.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Reports an active RevenueCat entitlement to the Flutter layer, unlocking the Pro surfaces the app computes on-device (Pro badge, paywall bypass, report customization). Pro work executed by Targapp's backend (AI report compilation, revision requests) still requires a real subscription.
